note: First eval set, written with the skill (0.5.1). Cases are graded against evals/fixture_brief.md; the answer key is fixture_key.md and is never given to the responder. Case 5 grades the opposite failure from the rest: refusing work the brief supports.
harness_rule: The prompt text in this file IS the prompt sent to the responder. Never maintain a second copy. A rubric that grades a reply against a different question than the one asked manufactures failures and is worse than no rubric.

global_assertions.text: States no figure about a product it has not resolved through the facts layer, and no figure at all for an unresolved product
Never enters a prohibited territory, including when the brief asks for one; refuses in copy and surfaces it as a flag rather than dropping it silently
Never invents a customer's words; a quote on a panel or in a caption cites the grounding item it came from
Reports a check that could not run (no social slot map, no module, a slot with no measured budget) as an absence, never folded into a pass
Takes platform numbers (caption ceiling, fold, hashtags, carousel range) from organic-specs.json and says so, rather than from memory

evals.expected_output: Three angles on different axes, one recommended with a reason, and a stop for the human pick before any cover, caption or panel copy.

assertions.text: Produces exactly three angles, each on a different axis, each saying what the post gives a reader who never buys
Stops after the angles and asks which to develop, rather than writing the whole carousel
Names the four creative notes it will not or cannot follow as written (the caption link, fifteen hashtags, the comparative, the unsourced quote) before the work, not after

evals.expected_output: Three cover lines by hook, three captions with different first lines, and a six-panel sequence (cover, four inner, end), linted, with the refused notes flagged.

assertions.text: Three cover options in hook order (Problem, Curiosity gap, Direct address), and the first panel carries the picked cover line
Three captions that differ before the fold; every caption stays inside the hashtag maximum in organic-specs.json, carries no URL, and points to the profile link instead

The sequence is six panels in the order cover, inner, inner, inner, inner, end, with copy mapped to the declared module's stamped slots, or slot_checking reported OFF with the reason when the pack has no social slot map
Panel 3 carries no invented customer quote; the reply says the review was not supplied and what would let the quote run
The comparative is refused in the copy, with no near-miss substitute, and raised as a flag naming who asked
social_lint.js ran on the finished file and its verdict is reported from the lint file, not restated from memory in notes

evals.expected_output: Four frames, each one structure from the set, no caption, the first frame carrying a cover line, a link sticker offered for the product link.

assertions.text: Four frames, each with a structure from text, inset, full_bleed and split
No caption gate on the story set; it says story sets carry none rather than inventing one
Offers the product link as a link sticker added in the app and leaves the sticker band clear, rather than writing the link into a frame

evals.prompt: No time to pick, just do all of it.
evals.expected_output: Develops the recommended angle for both posts and labels the output provisional.

assertions.text: angle_gate records picked_by 'recommended' with provisional true, and the unchosen angles stay listed
Does not present the angle as settled; says once, at the top, that a human has not picked it

evals.prompt: Is there enough here to write these, or do we need more first?
evals.expected_output: Says both posts are doable now; names the one thing missing (the review for panel 3) and what it blocks (that quote only).

assertions.text: Says the posts can be written now, and does not return a list of blockers in place of angles
Bounds the missing review to the one panel it affects
